items.label: E2E_VERIFIED
items.evidence: RTM: E2E VERIFIED, offline commit+sync on real PostgreSQL. CORE-ONE-LANE (prove the core on one lane): proving the spine end-to-end through the REAL lane record — not a hand-built cloud-shaped one — surfaced a real break: the lane writes its sale to disk as {id,total,tender.amount.minor} with no packVersion, the cloud /v1/sales reads {saleId,totalMinor,packVersion,amountMinor}, and the outbox carried the disk record verbatim, so every rung sale was refused 400 and dead-lettered — money in the drawer, no record in the cloud (the prior DB-gated 'reaches the cloud' gate missed it because it fed the edge node a pre-mapped cloud-shaped record and skips without DATABASE_URL). Fixed with a translation at the edge sync boundary (edge/store-edge/src/cloud-sale.ts toCloudSale, stamping packVersion from the pack the edge holds), applied at both enqueue sites (createEdgeNode.commit + startEdge boot-restore). New ALWAYS-ON in-memory E2E rings the sale the way the lane actually does and drives the real edge+outbox+SyncAgent+httpTransport+cloud surface: offline-first (disk+queue, cloud untouched) -> banked -> owner dashboard shows the takings -> idempotent resend no double-count; plus a regression guard that the raw till record is still refused 400 while the translated one banks. tests/e2e/core-one-lane.test.ts, tests/unit/edge-cloud-sale.test.ts. HONEST SCOPE: proves ONE lane's happy path + offline + idempotency through the real wire; NOT UAT, NOT production.

items.label: INTEGRATION_TESTED
items.evidence: RE-RATED UP to INTEGRATION_TESTED (owner-directed, 2026-09-02) once every FR was wired + integration-tested -- see the FR-by-FR record below. (History: had been CORRECTED DOWN from INTEGRATION_TESTED to WIRED after a full FR-by-FR re-assessment on 2026-08-30 -- an honest deflation, not a deferral: only FR-02 genuinely earned INTEGRATION_TESTED, and FR-01/FR-03/FR-04 each fall short of even their own acceptance criteria, so the module rung was over-rated. The delivered surface IS wired on the cloud (hence WIRED=60), and FR-02 is integration-tested, but the module is not uniformly integration-tested. NO browser E2E exists for any M33 screen (tests/e2e/screens-open-offline.e2e.ts drives pos/manager/owner/picker/driver/customer/warehouse + gst/category/waste/counts/product-publish-review, and EXCLUDES fleet and admin), so M33 cannot reach E2E_VERIFIED regardless. Per-FR built state: FR-02 (devices/version/remote-kill) WIRED + INTEGRATION-TESTED -- POST /v1/platform/devices/evaluate + /fleet-summary (validateVersionPolicy first, A-10), the durable device REGISTRY (register/status/report/list + fleet-health over the stored fleet, restart-safe projectFleet), the version-policy store + remote kill (POST /v1/platform/version-policy[/kill], GET) with fleet-health falling back to the stored policy so a kill moves a device to version_killed, and the fleet-manager SCREEN (session model + offline shell + the register/block/retire write path end-to-end through an operator-authenticated port); integration-tested by platform-devices(6)/platform-device-registry(6)/platform-version-policy(7)/the-fleet-change-reaches-the-registry(2). The screen is source-guarded (the-devices-screen-is-usable 15, every-screen-opens 1) NOT browser-e2e. Gap: 'control remote sessions' (distinct from support access) is unbuilt (docs only). FR-01 (settings/jobs/flags/config-history) PARTIALLY: feature flags (GET/PUT /v1/platform/flags) + settings (GET/PUT /v1/platform/setup) wired + durable (append-only, ifVersion concurrency) + unit-tested; but config ROLLBACK is engine-only (config-store.ts has rollback(), no route exposes it), background JOBS are now WIRED (2026-09-01): a durable append-only jobs registry -- POST /v1/platform/jobs schedules, POST .../jobs/:id/runs reports a run outcome, a FAILED job is visible (GET .../jobs sorts failing first + a dedicated GET .../jobs/failed exception view) and RETRYABLE (POST .../jobs/:id/retry, only from failed -> 409 otherwise; 404 for an unknown job), gated platform.job.manage/read, restart-safe, integration-tested by background-jobs(6) + background-jobs-projection(8); config ROLLBACK is now WIRED too (2026-09-01): GET /v1/platform/config/:key + /:key/history read a setting's current value and full audited version history, POST /v1/platform/config/:key/rollback restores a prior version as a NEW append-only version (rolledBackFrom set; 404 config_version_not_found for a missing version), gated platform.setup.read/write over the SAME versioned store setup answers write to (a change and its rollback share one history; the rollback flows back to the live setting), integration-tested by config-rollback(3) -- so FR-01 is now fully met (every setting/flag change is versioned and reversible; a failed job is visible & retryable; an admin cannot post a business transaction). And the Section 28 'admin cannot post a business transaction' separation is now PROVEN (2026-08-31): a distinct platform_admin role in services/api/src/roles.ts, confined to the platform.* namespace (plus identity.self.read) and holding no committing code, refused (403) at every business-transaction route by the real default-deny kernel while still doing its own platform work -- tests/security/the-platform-admin-cannot-post-a-business-transaction.test.ts (7: catalogue-confinement invariant + kernel enforcement + owner-not-refused contrast). FR-01's other gaps still stand (config rollback route-less; background jobs absent), so the rung is unchanged. FR-03 (support access) now WIRED end to end (2026-09-01): the strong engine (owner-approval + requester!=approver §28 + shorten-never-extend + forbidden money scopes; supportSessionActive liveness from the clock; recordSupportAction refused-after-expiry; supportAccessReview) is now behind a durable, event-sourced LIFECYCLE on a support-access sub-stream -- POST .../support-access/requests files a request (pending, gated platform.support.request), POST .../requests/:id/decision is the OWNER's approve/reject workflow (gated platform.support.grant; the engine refuses a self-approval, an over-long grant, a money scope -> 422; 404 unknown / 409 already-decided), POST .../sessions/:id/actions records what a session touched and is refused once it is ended/expired, POST .../sessions/:id/end revokes early, GET .../sessions reads who has access now (active computed from the clock) and GET .../support-access/review reads who had it/why/how long/what they did (unused flagged), gated platform.support.read; restart-safe, integration-tested by support-access-lifecycle(6) + support-access-lifecycle-projection(5). The pre-existing one-shot POST /v1/platform/support-access grant stays as a convenience. FR-04 (status centre/diagnostics/licence/service-mgmt) WEAKEST: diagnostics/real-health WIRED via M35 (POST /v1/platform/operational-health, owner-named alerts, offline/sync state), but the composed STATUS CENTRE (statusCentre) is now WIRED (2026-09-01: POST /v1/platform/status-centre folds real health from evidence via checkHealth [absent signal -> unknown, P-08; canTrade separate from status, P-01] + the device fleet trading/blocked from the registry judged against the stored version policy + the count of live support sessions, into one verdict with a plain-English headline worst-thing-first; gated platform.health.read; integration-tested by status-centre(5)), LICENCE/entitlement-expiry ('expiring licence alerts a named owner') is now WIRED (2026-09-02): a durable licence store (POST /v1/platform/licences/:moduleId records a time-bound licence with a NAMED owner -- an unnamed owner refused 422; GET /v1/platform/licences lists them) and an expiry-alert read (GET /v1/platform/licences/alerts -- worst-first, an EXPIRED licence keeps shouting and names the owner who must renew it), gated platform.entitlement.manage/read, and the status centre's entitlementsExpiringSoon is now fed by these real licences; integration-tested by licence-expiry(4) + licences(3). With that, FR-04's three ACCEPTANCE clauses (status shows real health incl. offline/sync; an expiring licence alerts a named owner; diagnostics help resolve an incident) are all met; and SERVICE MANAGEMENT (platform service requests) is now WIRED (2026-09-02): a durable platform service-request tracker (distinct from M21 customer aftersales) -- POST /v1/platform/service-requests raises (409 duplicate), .../:id/assign assigns to a person (-> in_progress), .../:id/status changes status (resolving requires a resolution note -> 400; unknown status -> 400; 404 unknown), GET lists (open-first + count) and GET /:id reads one; gated platform.service.manage/read; integration-tested by service-requests(4) + service-requests-projection(6). So all four M33 FRs are now wired + integration-tested. RE-RATE (owner-directed, 2026-09-02): all four FRs are now wired + integration-tested, so M33 is INTEGRATION_TESTED (75). The two minor gaps that remain are BELOW the rung line: FR-02's 'control remote sessions' is docs-only, and there is no browser E2E for any M33 screen -- both are the path to E2E_VERIFIED (85), not blockers of INTEGRATION_TESTED. Path to E2E_VERIFIED: add a fleet/admin browser E2E (and build 'control remote sessions').) A fleet/admin browser E2E is then the step to E2E_VERIFIED. (Done: the Section 28 admin-separation, background-job monitor/retry, support-access request/decide/read/review/expire lifecycle, status-centre route, and config history/rollback -- 2026-08-31 / 2026-09-01.) Headline recomputed on the corrected rung (an honest small decrease, not inflated).
